title: Feedly Threat Intelligence: Collect, analyze, and share actionable intelligence
content:
Feedly is the AI platform CTI teams use to track threats, contextualize what matters, and deliver tailored intel in minutes

Trusted by 380 CTI teams, including half of the Fortune 10

"Speed isn't just seeing the threat first. It's having a finished briefing in my CISO's inbox in minutes."

"I need AI grounded in what's happening now. Every answer should cite its sources, and flag when evidence is thin."

"Every stakeholder asks 'why does this matter to us?' Intel needs to answer that question, shaped for their language and actions."
